title: Dynamic code evaluation via Invoke-Expression (powershell) — review required
description: The powershell sink Invoke-Expression parses and runs a string as code. If the string contains untrusted input, an attacker achieves code execution in the application. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms every evaluated string is trusted or replaced with data-only parsing.
remediation: Remove the evaluation: parse data with direct cmdlets with parameters instead of running it as code. If evaluation is unavoidable, run it in a sandbox with no sensitive authority.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any Invoke-Expression call matches, including trusted uses such as local tooling. Whether the evaluated string is attacker-controlled needs human review.
